title: Which month of 2026 will have the highest ICE arrest total in the data publicly available by August 26, 2026?
background: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) carries out arrests as part of federal immigration enforcement.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Use government data supplied by ICE, as reported by The Associated Press.  
       Resolution Date : Resolve to the calendar month of 2026 with the largest arrest total among the months covered by the latest ICE monthly figures publicly available by August 26, 2026.  
       Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the month name only.
